data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing 12 customizable animated button widgets.
data.what_it_does: It offers a collection of animated button widgets with various visual styles such as shadow, neumorphic, slide, wave, and more. Each button is highly customizable via parameters for colors, icons, animations, and layout. The package works across all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need eye‑catching animated buttons without writing custom animations
You want a ready‑made set of diverse button styles for a cross‑platform app
You prefer declarative widget usage over manual animation code
avoid_when: You only need simple static buttons
You require minimal dependencies or a very small bundle size
You need button functionality that isn’t covered by the provided styles
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, web, desktop out of the box
weaknesses: Package is still early‑stage and may lack extensive documentation
Relies on flutter_inset_shadow which adds an extra dependency
